message:
Serviceability and Crowd Loading Specialist, the device now holds comfort with margin at resonance. A Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), a sprung mass moving out of phase to absorb deck motion, cuts the peak from lively to comfortable. The numbers are bare 1.75 m/s² per the bare single-ped resonant estimate (E22) falling to damped peak 0.106 m/s² per the damped response sweep (E32), below target 0.700 m/s², about 0.0108 g which is a small fraction of gravity like a still floor.

Retrofit and Maintenance Engineer and Under-Deck Integration Designer, the device moves very little so the hidden package stays shallow. The moving mass 800 kg tuned to 1.83 Hz per the Den Hartog sizing (E11) needs only millimetres of travel. The numbers are stroke 2.52 mm per the damped response sweep (E32) inside plus-minus 30 mm clearance, with hung load 9.81 kN per the hung load estimate (E29), about thirteen body weights.

The Manager, the integrated proposal hangs the Tuned Mass Damper (TMD) cassette at midspan from the girder bottom flanges with no deck change. Ready, because damped acceleration and stroke clear the blocking objection with buildable hardware.
